# FormFieldLib:defaultPaint

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--new">since 26.2.0</span></div>

Draw the field with its default look, i.e. from the paint handler of a button or a boolean field.

```lua
field:defaultPaint()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local button
button = form.addButton(line, nil, {text="OK", press=onPress, paint=function()
  button:defaultPaint()
  lcd.drawFilledCircle(8, 8, 4)
end})
```
